title: Beyond IID: How General Are Tabular Foundation Models, Really?
abstract: arXiv:2606.30410v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Foundation models for predictive machine learning on tabular data have recently gained significant traction in academia and industry. Research communities across disciplines are increasingly evaluating tabular foundation models on diverse datasets and tasks. However, these task- and discipline-specific evaluations remain largely inaccessible to model researchers because benchmark software and evaluation protocols are fragmented. As a result, model researchers rely on standard benchmarks, which are mostly defined for tasks where tabular foundation models already excel. The most challenging scenarios are excluded, limiting meaningful progress in the field by focusing on marginal improvements on IID data rather than on broader, more demanding challenges. translated_title: 超越IID：表格基础模型到底有多通用？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.30410v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：用于表格数据预测性机器学习的基础模型近来在学术界和工业界获得了显著关注。各学科的研究社区正越来越多地在多样化的数据集和任务上评估表格基础模型。然而，这些针对特定任务和学科的评估对模型研究人员而言在很大程度上是难以获取的，因为基准测试软件和评估协议是碎片化的。因此，模型研究人员只能依赖标准基准，而这些基准大多是针对表格基础模型已经表现卓越的任务定义的。最具挑战性的场景被排除在外，这使得该领域的研究聚焦于IID数据上的边际改进，而非更广泛、更具挑战性的问题，从而限制了有意义的进展。为了克服这一问题，我们提出了BeyondArena，这是首个统一的表格数据整体性基准，支持多样化的任务类型（IID、时序、分组），覆盖不同规模的样本量和特征……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了首个统一的表格数据整体性基准BeyondArena，通过支持IID、时序、分组等多种任务类型并突破现有评估碎片化、局限于IID场景的问题，推动对表格基础模型真正通用性的评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BeyondArena, the first unified holistic benchmark for tabular data that supports diverse task types (IID, temporal, grouped), addressing fragmented evaluation practices and enabling assessment of tabular foundation models' true generality beyond marginal IID improvements.
